# Method GetEnumerationValues

#### GetEnumerationValues(Guid, out List<int>, out List<string>)

Gets the possible values of an enumeration.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
void GetEnumerationValues(Guid inGuid, out List<int> outValues, out List<string> outTexts)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  Guid |  inGuid |  GUID of the enumeration definition to analyze.  |  
 
|  List<int> |  outValues |  Possible values.  |  
 
|  List<string> |  outTexts |  Texts of the possible values.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
